# LinkedIn Draft - 2026-09-16

Cloudflare changes crawler controls; training Block now includes search bots, with a Bing opt-out gap.

Went through 40 links today. Here's what made the brief:

1. Check crawler controls before selecting Block
   Review crawler settings to avoid accidental search exclusion or overstated training protection.

2. Evaluate whether the same agent succeeds again
   Measure repeatability alongside average success before trusting agent workflows.

3. Scope Workers credentials to the application
   Reduce token privileges and test deployment permissions before migrating.
